whenToUse: Forms where changing values while saving would tangle the result.
Several controls in one area must be blocked at once.
The task finishes within a few seconds.
whenNotToUse: You'd block the whole page (cover only the area that needs it).
Long tasks (use a progress notice and let people do other things).
Only one button needs blocking (disabling it and a status message are enough).

alternatives.name: Progress Toast
alternatives.reason: People can do other things during the task.

alternatives.name: Spinner
alternatives.reason: Showing the state of only a button or small area.

accessibility: Put inert on the covered content to block clicks, focus, and assistive technology.
Give the area aria-busy, and put the "Saving" message in a role="status" outside the inert part.
When it's done, announce the result ("Saved") as status.
Transitions and rotation turn off with reduced motion.
